items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He could take a bow and make a bow play so -- he could take a bow just like, to me, the greatest guy I know today -- all due respects to you because you know I love you -- but, to me, I can listen to Richard Davis take a bow --

ctx.x: That's how I first met him when he was a Golden Glove boxer in Chicago.

He could take a bow and make a bow play so -- he could take a bow just like, to me, the greatest guy I know today -- all due respects to you because you know I love you -- but, to me, I can listen to Richard Davis take a bow --
